arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
rows = {}
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % ns['m']):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    cells = {}
    for c in row.iter('{%s}c' % ns['m']):
        ref = c.get('r')
        col = re.match(r'[A-Z]+', ref).group()
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        is_ = c.find('m:is', ns)
        if v is not None:
            cells[col] = float(v.text) if t == 'n' else v.text
        elif is_ is not None:
            txt = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{%s}t' % ns['m']))
            cells[col] = txt
        else:
            f = c.find('m:f', ns)
            cells[col] = ('FORMULA:' + (f.text or '')) if f is not None else None
    rows[r] = cells
exp = {11: ('Housing','Rent/Mortgage',1500), 12: ('Housing','Utilities',200), 13: ('Housing','Insurance',150),
       14: ('Transportation','Car Payment',350), 15: ('Transportation','Gas',150), 16: ('Transportation','Insurance',100),
       17: ('Food','Groceries',500), 18: ('Food','Dining Out',200), 19: ('Entertainment','Streaming',50),
       20: ('Entertainment','Hobbies',100), 21: ('Savings','Emergency Fund',500), 22: ('Savings','Retirement',400)}
from collections import defaultdict
cat = defaultdict(float)
total = 0.0
for r, (c, item, amt) in exp.items():
    cat[c] += amt
    total += amt
print('Per-category totals:')
for c, v in cat.items():
    print(f'  {c}: {v:,.2f}')
print(f'TOTAL EXPENSES: {total:,.2f}')
print('Formula in C23:', rows[23].get('C'))
print('Formula in B8 (Total Income):', rows[8].get('B'))
print('Formula in B25 (Balance):', rows[25].get('B'))
"
